jobs.person_note: The SAME man as in the attached photo: same face, silver-grey combed-back hair, navy quarter-zip sweater over white t-shirt; do not change his face shape.
jobs.style: A finished, minimal, eye-catching vertical Instagram Reels COVER, cinematic photo with bold typography. Bold, clean, perfectly spelled Russian typography is REQUIRED. No logos, no watermarks, no UI elements.

jobs.prompt: Vertical 9:16 cover. The man from the reference sits at a dark wooden desk in a warm studio with a sunset-orange wall and a green palm plant, calm firm fatherly look into the camera, forearms on the desk; he occupies the upper half and centre, from the chest up, face fully visible and NOT covered by text. Typography between 55% and 78% of the image height, centred over his sweater, with a soft dark gradient behind it: bold white condensed uppercase «ПРИНЯЛ РЕШЕНИЕ —», under it larger bold warm beige uppercase «ПЕРЕСТАНЬ СОМНЕВАТЬСЯ» in two lines. No other text.
